notes: NovaShell now forwards a second connected Xbox controller to player two for every supported EmulatorJS core, not only N64 titles.
changes: Two-controller routing is now core-neutral for owned GBA, Game Boy, NES, SNES, Genesis, N64, and PlayStation imports.
The controller pump was regression-tested with two synthetic gamepads after the local runtime repair.
Games without local multiplayer keep their normal behavior and simply ignore player two input.
